title: Sigma Lithium July 2026 production and environmental update
excerpt: Sigma disclosed negotiations with the Minas Gerais state government following approximately USD 540,000 of environmental fines and stated that second-quarter production beat its 33,000-tonne target.
summary: The latest SEC-hosted issuer update adds a second-quarter production beat but also a live environmental-regulatory dispute; it does not update the March financial statements or resolve liquidity, going-concern, receivables, or control weaknesses.
